sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Current green blocks:
# Row 25: cols 25, 31, 37, 43, 49 (5 blocks)
# Row 31: cols 13, 19, 25, 31, 37, 43, 49 (7 blocks)
# I have 5 actions left in this round
# Strategy: clear all 5 blocks in top row, then see if LEFT works

seg = current_frame.segmentation
greens = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']

# Get top row blocks only
top_row = []
for g in greens:
    b = g['boundary']
    minr = min(row for row, col in b)
    minc = min(col for row, col in b)
    if minr == 25:
        top_row.append((minr, minc))

top_row.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
print(f"Top row blocks: {top_row}")

# Click all top row blocks
clicks = [{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': r, 'col': c} for r, c in top_row]
action(clicks)

seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
greens2 = [n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"After clearing top row: {len(greens2)} green blocks")
print(f"gameplay_changed={last_action_result.get('gameplay_changed')}")

# Check remaining blocks
remaining = []
for g in greens2:
    b = g['boundary']
    minr = min(row for row, col in b)
    minc = min(col for row, col in b)
    remaining.append((minr, minc))
remaining.sort()
print(f"Remaining: {remaining}")

# Now try moving LEFT - only 1 action left
action(['LEFT'])
print(f"After LEFT: level_completed={last_action_result.get('level_completed')}, done={last_action_result.get('done')}")

seg3 = current_frame.segmentation
greens3 = [n for n in seg3['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Green blocks after LEFT: {len(greens3)}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
